name: Raster band statistics
description: Calculate exact descriptive statistics for valid stored pixel samples in selected raster bands.

bands.description: Optional 1-based band indexes; omitted means every band.

preconditions: Input is a readable raster supported by the installed GDAL drivers.
Selected band indexes are unique 1-based indexes within the dataset band count.
Every selected band contains at least one finite, non-nodata pixel.
Nodata and masked pixels are excluded.
Statistics describe raw stored samples; scale and offset metadata are reported but not applied.
Every valid pixel is processed without sampling or approximation.
semantics: Nodata and masked pixels are excluded.
Statistics describe raw stored sample values; GDAL scale and offset are reported but not applied.
Standard deviation is the population standard deviation (ddof=0).
All valid pixels are processed; no sampling or approximation is performed.
validation_requirements: Each selected band appears exactly once in the result.
Standard deviation is the population standard deviation (ddof=0).
Statistics describe raw stored sample values; scale and offset metadata are not applied.
Reported dimensions match the source raster.
